caption:
The book was older than the building. I let it set the pace.

#newyorkcity #library #manuscript
alt_text: Seen from a carved wooden balcony above a dark walnut library: a woman whose bare shoulders, back and carved curls are polished grey-ivory marble with thin gold veins, in a sage halter and brown trousers, sits alone at a long table under green lamps, one hand on a huge illuminated manuscript.
